words.gloss: to those who do not let go

literal: Grasping and not letting go are sorrows, attachment grasping and to those who do not let go.
translation: Sorrows will take hold and never let go of those who hold on to their attachments and never let them go.
modern: பற்றுகளைப் பிடித்துக்கொண்டு அவற்றை விடாதவர்களை, துன்பங்களும் விடாமல் பிடித்துக்கொள்ளும்.
explanation: This couplet creates a striking parallel between human action and the reaction of sorrow. The word 'பற்று' is used both as a noun meaning 'attachment' and as a verb meaning 'to grasp'. If a person grasps their attachments and refuses to let them go, sorrows will in turn grasp that person and refuse to let go. The repetition of the phrase 'பற்றி விடாஅ' (grasping and not letting go) emphasizes that suffering is the direct and inescapable mirror of clinging to worldly things.
